== decision.eligibility reason=coverage_unsatisfied
outcome decision.eligibility.outcome
  1 of 2 subjects may be scored under the task’s evidence policy.
  record=inspection:i-1
reason decision.inspection.coverage_unsatisfied
  1 subject is held because a required coverage measurement is missing, unknown or insufficient: subject2.
  record=inspection:i-1 subject=subject2
  identifiers subject2
next decision.eligibility.next
  Subjects that may not be scored are inspected ordinarily; fix the evidence named above and request a new decision to score them.
  record=inspection:i-1
